views.markdown: See the hours, minutes and seconds until your alarms, updated live in Apple's Clock app. Sleep Left adds the countdown beneath each ordinary alarm, alongside your existing label.
Enabled and disabled alarms both show a countdown. For a disabled alarm, the countdown is a preview; the alarm stays off. Sleep/Wake Up alarms are not included.

screenshots.accessibilityText: Clock Alarms showing enabled 6:10 AM and 5:20 PM countdowns and a gray disabled 11:45 AM countdown preview.

views.markdown: Live countdowns beneath ordinary alarms. The gray, disabled alarm is a preview and stays off.
Install Sleep Left, fully close and reopen Clock, then open Alarms. No Settings pane or extra configuration.
Independently developed by **0chium**, inspired by **AlarmTime by P2KDev**. Original code and included crescent artwork are MIT licensed. No AlarmTime code or artwork is included.

The owner reports initial functional passes for **0.1.0~alpha1** on **iPhone 14 Pro — iOS 17.0 (21A329)** and **iPhone 11 Pro Max — iOS 18.3.2 (22D82)**, without another alarm-countdown tweak active. Checks covered enabled/disabled countdowns, custom labels, editing/toggling, scrolling without duplicate or mismatched text, and catch-up after returning to Clock. These are owner reports, not comprehensive compatibility, accessibility, calendar-edge-case or performance certification. The final **0.1.0** package has not itself received device testing.

Sleep/Wake Up is excluded. No blanket iOS 17/18 or iOS 26 support. Other configurations and RootHide conversion are unverified. Recurrence/DST and snooze/time-zone edge cases are not comprehensively tested. VoiceOver custom content and large text remain unverified by owner testing. No measured battery, CPU or reliability claims. Countdown units are English.
If another alarm-countdown tweak is installed, disable or remove it so only one modifies the alarm rows.

First public release as Sleep Left. Accepted implementation unchanged from the tested alpha. New package identity, approved crescent artwork, source/support links and documentation. Conflicts with and replaces com.ochium.fivemoreminutes; one injection pair, with internal names retained.
This final package has not itself received device testing.
